blocks.heading: Promotion in marketing
blocks.text: Promotion is the entire set of activities which communicate the product, brand, service or business to customers. It can inform, persuade, remind or support relationships. It includes advertising, sales promotion, personal selling and public relations, rather than only a price cut. The message and method should fit the target, objective and budget. Promotion can create awareness but cannot guarantee purchases, especially if supply or product suitability is weak. It differs from job promotion, an employee’s move to a higher position.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Eya Repairs demonstrates its service and supplies clear booking information. These activities communicate its offer to customers. Appointing a worker as supervisor is a different use of promotion, concerning a job.

blocks.heading: Keeping the ideas apart
blocks.text:
Explain the different meanings: Tano Tools promotes a new bag to customers and later promotes a worker to supervisor.

The customer activity is marketing communication about an offering. The worker’s promotion is movement to a higher job position. The shared word does not make the staffing decision a sales-promotion method.
